blocks.title: Storage Paths & Decryption
blocks.body:
# MiliNav – Storage Paths & File Destinations

## Quick visual

![Offline map packaging flow](/media/diagrams/map-package-flow.svg)

### 7-Zip packaging reference

When packaging encrypted map folders for SD card deployment, configure 7-Zip as shown:

![7-Zip window configuration](/media/attachments/7zip_window_configuration.png)

This note documents **all storage types** and **full path patterns** used for decryption, unzip, cache, and map files.  
Package: **`com.milinav`**.  
Paths below use Android’s standard locations; actual device paths may vary (e.g. `/storage/emulated/0` vs `/sdcard`).

---

## 1. Path patterns (full destination paths)

### 1.1 Internal cache (app-private, no SD)

| Purpose | Full path pattern | Used by |
|--------|--------------------|---------|
| Temp folder | `{cacheDir}/temp` | Internal cache temp files |
| Internal cache dir | `/data/data/com.milinav/cache` or `/data/user/0/com.milinav/cache` | `context.cacheDir` |
| Temp subfolder | `/data/data/com.milinav/cache/temp` | `File(context.cacheDir, FileUtil.TEMP_FOLDER)` |

**File types:** Temp/decrypted files when using internal cache only (e.g. `createTempFileInInternalCache`).

---

### 1.2 Preferred: removable SD card (when available)

Cache and decrypted map **prefer the removable SD card** to save device internal storage.

| Purpose | Full path pattern | Used by |
|--------|--------------------|---------|
| SD card temp (cache) | `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files/temp` | `getOrCreateSDCardCacheDir()` |
| **Decrypted output (preferred)** | `.../files/temp/.corpDcrTp_*.mmpk` or `.corpDcrOm_*.mmpk` | `createTempFileForDecryptionPreferSDCard()` when SD present |

**File types:** Unzipped cache copy and **final decrypted map file** when SD card is present.

---

### 1.3 External cache (fallback when no SD card)

When **no removable SD card** is available, cache and decrypted file use primary external storage.

| Purpose | Full path pattern | Used by |
|--------|--------------------|---------|
| External cache root | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache` | `context.externalCacheDir` |
| Temp subfolder | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache/temp` | `getOrCreateExternalCacheDir()` |
| **Decrypted output (fallback)** | `.../cache/temp/.corpDcrTp_*.mmpk` or `.corpDcrOm_*.mmpk` | `createTempFileForDecryptionPreferSDCard()` fallback |

**File types:** Unzipped copy 1 and **final decrypted map file** when no SD card.

---

### 1.4 External cache (legacy / reference – app-specific on primary storage)

| Purpose | Full path pattern | Used by |
|--------|--------------------|---------|
| External cache root | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache` | `context.externalCacheDir` |
| Temp subfolder | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache/temp` | `getOrCreateExternalCacheDir()` |
| **Decrypted output (current flow)** | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache/temp/.corpDcrTp_*.mmpk` (topo) or `.corpDcrOm_*.mmpk` (OSM) | `createTempFileInCacheExternalStorage()` → decryption output |

**Is this on an “external drive”?**  
- **Yes** in Android’s sense: it’s on **external storage** (`externalCacheDir` = app cache on primary external storage).  
- **In practice:** that is usually the **device’s main/built-in storage** (e.g. `/storage/emulated/0`), **not** the removable SD card. The decrypted `.mmpk` file lives on the **primary external storage**, which on most phones is the internal drive. A physical SD card is **secondary** external storage (see §1.4).

**File types:**  
- Unzipped content (dual storage: **copy 1**).  
- **Final decrypted map file** (topo or OSM) created by `createTempFileInCacheExternalStorage()` and written by `DecryptionHelper`.

---

### 1.4 External files (app-specific, primary storage)

| Purpose | Full path pattern | Used by |
|--------|--------------------|---------|
| App files root | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/files` | `context.getExternalFilesDir(null)` |
| Temp folder (scoped) | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/files/temp` | `createCacheOnSDCard()` → `createScopedCacheFolder()` (Android 10+) |
| **Manual temp – topo** | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/files/manual_temp/topo` | `getOrCreateManualTempFolder(ctx, mapTypeTOPO)` |
| **Manual temp – OSM** | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/files/manual_temp/osm` | `getOrCreateManualTempFolder(ctx, mapTypeOSM)` |

**File types:**  
- Unzipped zip contents (dual storage: **copy 2**): encrypted part files (e.g. `mrso37.zip`, `brso1.zip`), `_info.json`.  
- Listing of encrypted parts and reading `_info.json` for decryption is done from this **manual_temp** path.

---

### 1.5 SD card / secondary external storage (when present)

| Purpose | Full path pattern | Used by |
|--------|--------------------|---------|
| SD app files root | `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files` (e.g. `/storage/7B4A-5CE8/Android/data/com.milinav/files`) | `context.getExternalFilesDirs(null).firstOrNull { Environment.isExternalStorageRemovable(it) }` |
| SD temp folder | `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files/temp` | `createTempFileInSDCardCache()`, `createCacheOnSDCard()` (when removable storage is used) |

**File types:**  
- Optional temp/decrypted files when using “SD card cache” (e.g. `createTempFileInSDCardCache()`).  
- Legacy path (Android 9 and below): `Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()` → `/storage/emulated/0` + `temp` → `/storage/emulated/0/temp`.

---

### 1.6 User-visible / download paths (encrypted zip source)

| Purpose | Full path pattern | Notes |
|--------|--------------------|--------|
| Encrypted zip (topo) | Set in prefs `topoDownloadedEncryptedFolderPathOutput`; e.g. user-selected path like `/storage/emulated/0/DCIM/encrypted/MRSO.zip` | Source zip for manual topo flow |
| Encrypted zip (OSM) | Set in prefs `osmDownloadedEncryptedFolderPathOutput` | Source zip for manual OSM flow |

**File types:**  
- User-selected encrypted zip (e.g. `MRSO.zip`).  
- Not created by the app; path comes from user selection.

---

## 2. Flow summary: where each file type ends up

| File type | Final / main destination path(s) |
|-----------|-----------------------------------|
| **Decrypted map (topo)** | **With SD card:** `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files/temp/.corpDcrTp_<random>.mmpk` · **No SD:** `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache/temp/.corpDcrTp_<random>.mmpk` |
| **Decrypted map (OSM)** | **With SD card:** `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files/temp/.corpDcrOm_<random>.mmpk` · **No SD:** `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache/temp/.corpDcrOm_<random>.mmpk` |
| **Unzipped content (cache copy)** | **With SD card:** `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files/temp/...` · **No SD:** `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache/temp/...` (e.g. `mrso1.zip`, `_info.json`) |
| **Unzipped content (external copy)** | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/files/manual_temp/topo/...` or `.../manual_temp/osm/...` (same entry names) |
| **Encrypted part zips** (after unzip) | Same as “Unzipped content” above (inside `manual_temp/topo` or `manual_temp/osm`) |
| **_info.json** (after unzip) | Same dirs as above; read from `manual_temp/topo` or `manual_temp/osm` for key/nonce/numParts |
| **Temp chunk files** (during decryption) | System temp dir (e.g. `File.createTempFile("chunk", null)`) – created and deleted during stream decryption |

---

## 3. Constants and prefixes

| Constant | Value | Use |
|----------|--------|-----|
| `FileUtil.TEMP_FOLDER` | `"temp"` | Subfolder name under cache or external files |
| `MainNavigator.DECRYPTED_FILE_PREFIX` | `".corpDcrTp_"` | Topo decrypted file prefix |
| `MainNavigator.DECRYPTED_FILE_PREFIX_OSM` | `".corpDcrOm_"` | OSM decrypted file prefix |
| `MainNavigator.DECRYPTED_FILE_SUFFIX` | `".mmpk"` | Decrypted map extension |
| Manual temp subdir (topo) | `manual_temp/topo` | Under `getExternalFilesDir(null)` |
| Manual temp subdir (OSM) | `manual_temp/osm` | Under `getExternalFilesDir(null)` |

---

## 4. Error handling (reference)

- **Storage full:** User message from `error_storage_full` (e.g. “Storage full. Free up space and try again.”).  
- **Low memory / OOM:** User message from `error_not_enough_memory` (e.g. “Not enough memory. Close other apps and try again.”).  
- Unzip checks free space (e.g. `zip.length() * 4`) in both cache and external dirs before extracting.  
- Decryption and file creation paths use `getUserFriendlyDecryptionError` / `getUserFriendlyStorageOrMemoryError` and Toasts for user-visible errors.

---

## 5. Quick reference – path by storage type

| Storage type | Base path | Temp/sub path | Typical use |
|--------------|-----------|----------------|-------------|
| **Internal cache** | `/data/data/com.milinav/cache` | `.../cache/temp` | Old/internal temp; not primary for current decryption |
| **SD card (preferred)** | `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files` | `.../files/temp` | **Decrypted .mmpk + cache** when SD present |
| **External cache (fallback)** | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/cache` | `.../cache/temp` | **Decrypted .mmpk** when no SD; unzip copy 1 |
| **External files (primary)** | `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.milinav/files` | `.../files/temp`, `.../files/manual_temp/topo`, `.../files/manual_temp/osm` | Unzip copy 2; encrypted parts; _info.json |
| **SD card (if present)** | `/storage/<volume-id>/Android/data/com.milinav/files` | `.../files/temp` | Optional SD temp/decrypt |

All of these are app-private; uninstall removes them.

---

## 6. Flow process: from zip on SD card to decrypted map

End-to-end flow starting from the user selecting the encrypted zip (e.g. on SD card or external storage) through to the decrypted map being ready for use.

| Step | What happens | Where (path / component) |
|------|----------------|-------------------------|
| **1. Get zip from SD card / storage** | User picks the encrypted zip (e.g. `MRSO.zip`) from external/SD storage. App receives its path (`localFilePath`). | Any user-accessible path, e.g. `/storage/emulated/0/DCIM/encrypted/MRSO.zip` or SD path like `/storage/<volume-id>/.../MRSO.zip`. |
| **2. Save zip path** | Path is stored in preferences so the app knows which zip to use for this map type. | Prefs: `topoDownloadedEncryptedFolderPathOutput` (topo) or `osmDownloadedEncryptedFolderPathOutput` (OSM). `PreUnzipFileHelper.setEncryptedFolderPath()`. |
| **3. Validate & prepare dirs** | App checks the zip file exists. Then it gets/creates: (a) external cache dir for unzip + decrypted output, (b) manual temp dir for unzip (topo or OSM). | Zip: path from prefs. Cache: `FileUtil.getOrCreateExternalCacheDir()` → `.../Android/data/com.milinav/cache/temp`. Manual temp: `FileUtil.getOrCreateManualTempFolder(ctx, mapType)` → `.../files/manual_temp/topo` or `.../files/manual_temp/osm`. |
| **4. Create decrypted output file** | A single empty temp file is created where the combined decrypted map will be written. | `FileUtil.createTempFileInCacheExternalStorage()` → e.g. `.../cache/temp/.corpDcrTp_<random>.mmpk` (topo) or `.corpDcrOm_*.mmpk` (OSM). |
| **5. Check free space** | Before unzip, app checks that both cache and manual_temp have enough free space (estimated as zip size × 4). | `FileUtil.hasEnoughSpaceInDir(cacheDir, …)` and `hasEnoughSpaceInDir(externalDir, …)`. If not enough → toast “Storage full…” and stop. |
| **6. Unzip to dual storage** | Zip is extracted so each entry is written to **both** cache and manual_temp. Progress and UI updated per entry. When `_info.json` is found, it is parsed for key, nonce, numParts. | **Copy 1:** `.../cache/temp/` (e.g. `mrso1.zip`, `mrso2.zip`, `_info.json`). **Copy 2:** `.../files/manual_temp/topo/` or `.../manual_temp/osm/` (same names). `PreUnzipFileHelper.unzipToTempFolderDualStorage()`. |
| **7. Read key material** | From the manual_temp copy, app finds `_info.json` and reads `key`, `iv` (nonce), `numParts`, `originalChecksum`. | File: `.../files/manual_temp/topo/_info.json` (or `osm`). `readEntityValueFromJson()`, `containsMainInfoJson()`. |
| **8. List encrypted part zips** | App lists part files (e.g. `mrso1.zip`, `mrso2.zip`, …) from manual_temp, sorted by part number. | Dir: `.../files/manual_temp/topo/` or `.../manual_temp/osm/`. Filter: `prefixFileName` + digits + `.zip`; ignore `._*` and `__MACOSX`. |
| **9. Clean old decrypted cache** | Any existing decrypted file with the same prefix in the same cache is deleted so only one decrypted map exists. | `FileUtil.deleteAnySimilarCacheFile(ctx, decryptedFilePrefix, outputFile.absolutePath)`. |
| **10. Decrypt and combine** | For each part zip in order: read from zip → decrypt with key/nonce (streaming) → append to the single output file. Progress 0–100% shown. On first error (e.g. no space, OOM), process stops and user sees a toast. | **Input:** part zips in `.../files/manual_temp/topo/` (or osm). **Output:** `.../cache/temp/.corpDcrTp_*.mmpk` (or OSM). `DecryptionHelper.decryptAndCombineUsingStaticKey()`. |
| **11. Save decrypted path** | The path of the final decrypted file is saved in preferences so the map screen can load it. | Prefs: `topoDecryptedFilePathOutput` or `osmDecryptedFilePathOutput`. `Preferences.setPreference(ctx, preferenceKey, filePath)`. |
| **12. Confirm & update UI** | App checks that the decrypted file exists in cache and updates the “critical” button / map-ready state. | `FileUtil.isFileExistingInInternalCacheDirectory(…)` (or equivalent check); `viewVisibility.criticalButtonVisibility(mapType, isExisted)`. |

**Summary:** Zip path (SD/external) → saved in prefs → unzip to **cache/temp** and **files/manual_temp/topo|osm** → read key from _info.json in manual_temp → list part zips from manual_temp → decrypt parts in order into **cache/temp/.corpDcrTp_*.mmpk** → save that path in prefs → map loads from that path.
